subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear Mr. Smith, We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on August 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Departure: 08:00 AM Arrival: 03:00 PM Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
